Class RayTest

java.lang.Object
primitives.RayTest
class RayTest extends Object
Unit tests for class Ray. The tests verify:
  • Ray constructor validity
  • Ray.direction()
  • Ray.origin()
Tests follow the methodology of Equivalence Partitions (EP) and Boundary Values (BVA).

  • Method Details

    • testConstructor

      @Test void testConstructor()
      Test method for Ray(Point, Vector).

      Verifies that a ray is built without exception and that its direction is automatically normalized regardless of the supplied vector's length.

    • direction

      @Test void direction()
      Test method for Ray.direction().

      Verifies that the returned direction is the normalized version of the vector supplied to the constructor.

    • origin

      @Test void origin()
      Test method for Ray.origin().

      Verifies that the returned origin equals the point supplied to the constructor and is never affected by direction normalization.

    • getPointTest

      @Test void getPointTest()
      Test Ray.getPoint(double) with various parameter values.
